responsibility: This file provides the C++ scheduling and hazard-analysis helpers used by the NDS32 pipeline descriptions. Within the nds32::scheduling namespace it classifies load/store access direction, extracts the real micro-operation order and accessed registers from single-, double-, and multiple-word memory instructions, and implements per-core dependency predicates such as EX-to-EX, MM-to-EX, and load-to-stage hazards for N10, Graywolf, and N13/N12 models. These functions are the procedural guard layer referenced by the per-core pipeline .md files when GCC’s automaton scheduler needs target-specific bypass and conflict decisions.
